about: The same synthetic project, adopted and installed with BOWERLOOM_PREVIEW_ENGINES=1 for OpenCode, Pi, and DeepSeek Harness. Made by tools/fixtures-0.8/make.mjs from the published bowerloom@0.8.0-beta.1. Each key of "files" is a path with its mode and its text, or base64 when the bytes are not UTF-8. Paths hold the placeholders {{HOME}}, {{PROJECT}}, {{STATE}}, {{PROJECT_ID}}, and {{ROOT}} (the folder above HOME). An address of a person in package metadata is {{EMAIL}}.

.codex/config.toml.text:
# A server this project keeps by hand. Its tool allow list has no neutral form, so adoption leaves it here.
[mcp_servers.local-notes]
command = "notes-server"
args = ["--port", "4000"]
enabled_tools = ["read"]

# Bowerloom writes the tables below. Removal restores this file as it was.
[mcp_servers.lint]
command = "lint-server"
args = ["--fix"]
# End of the tables Bowerloom writes.

.codex/rules/bowerloom.rules.text:
# Bowerloom writes this file from the guardrails of a harness definition. Removal restores what was here before.
# A neutral allow never becomes a Codex allow rule: Codex would run the command outside the sandbox without asking.

prefix_rule(
    pattern = ["rm", "-rf"],
    decision = "forbidden",
    justification = "Bowerloom guardrail deny-shell-abbb71ff",
)

.dsh/bowerloom.patch.yml.text:
# Bowerloom writes this file from the MCP servers of a harness definition. Pass it to DeepSeek Harness with
# dsh web --patch .dsh/bowerloom.patch.yml
# Bowerloom never edits cordis.patch.yml. Removal restores what was here before.
- insert:
    - id: "bowerloom-mcp-files"
      name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client"
      config:
        serverName: "files"
        transport: "stdio"
        command: "npx"
        args: ["-y", "files-server"]
        env:
          API_TOKEN: !!js "process.env.TOKEN"
    - id: "bowerloom-mcp-lint"
      name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client"
      config:
        serverName: "lint"
        transport: "stdio"
        command: "lint-server"
        args: ["--fix"]
